text: In a dual-polarization coherent optical system, which modulation format delivers a spectral efficiency of about 8 bits/s/Hz (requiring roughly 16 dB SNR)?
explanation: DP-16QAM carries 4 bits/symbol over two polarizations for about 8 bits/s/Hz at ~16 dB SNR, and is the basis of 400G coherent links. OOK is ~1 bit/s/Hz, PAM4 ~2, and DP-QPSK ~4 bits/s/Hz, all lower.
